error_not_found_description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
error_generic_description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
common_invalid_input: Please check your input and try again.
common_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
common_rate_limited_generic: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
reauth_code_hint: Also enter the current code from your authenticator app.
reauth_missing_code: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
reauth_invalid_code: The authentication code is not valid.
login_description: Sign in to manage your content.
login_invalid_input: Enter a valid email address and your password.
login_invalid_credentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Signing in to this account is paused for 15 minutes.
login_two_factor_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_two_factor_backup_description: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works only once.
login_two_factor_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please sign in again.
login_two_factor_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
panel_welcome_description: Write and publish posts in several languages, manage your images and, depending on your role, users, languages and integrations. The documentation explains every part of the panel.
password_description: Use at least 12 characters. Common passwords are not accepted.
password_forced_notice: Choose a new password before you continue.
password_changed: Your password has been changed and your other sessions were signed out.
password_too_short: The new password must be at least 12 characters long.
password_too_long: The new password must be at most 128 characters long.
password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose one that is harder to guess.
password_too_predictable: This password leans too much on your name, your email address or the name of this site. Choose one that is harder to guess.
password_reused: The new password must be different from the current one.
password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
two_factor_description: Protect your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
two_factor_required_notice: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
two_factor_start_description: Enter your password to start the setup.
two_factor_pending_description: The setup is in progress. Enter a code from your authenticator app to finish it, or start over.
two_factor_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually.
two_factor_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
two_factor_backup_codes_save: Save these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
two_factor_confirm_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish the setup.
two_factor_not_started: The setup was not started or has been replaced. Please start again.
two_factor_regenerate_description: Create a new set of backup codes. The old codes stop working.
two_factor_disable_description: Your other sessions will be signed out.
sessions_description: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.
sessions_revoked_others: All other sessions were signed out.
error_forbidden_description: You do not have permission to open this page.
link_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
users_description: Invite people and manage their access.
users_invite_description: The new user chooses their own password through a one-time link.
users_invite_created: Invitation created for {name}. Send them this one-time link. It expires in 72 hours.
users_email_taken: A user with this email address already exists.
user_deactivate_description: The user can no longer sign in and all of their sessions end immediately. Their posts stay as they are.
user_reactivate_description: The user can sign in again.
user_role_description: Changing the role signs the user out everywhere. Confirm with your password.
user_publish_description: Authors who may publish directly skip the approval queue.
user_reset_description: Create a one-time link that lets the user choose a new password. It expires in 30 minutes and replaces older links.
user_reset_created: Send this one-time link to the user. It expires in 30 minutes.
user_invite_description: Create a new one-time invitation link. It expires in 72 hours and replaces older links.
user_invite_created: Send this one-time link to the user. It expires in 72 hours.
user_not_applicable: This action is not available for this user.
invite_completed: Your account is ready. You can now sign in.
reset_completed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.
audit_description: Security-relevant events. Entries cannot be changed or removed.
profile_description: Your name and bio appear on your published posts. Language and theme apply to the panel.
profile_bio_hint: A short introduction shown with your posts.
languages_description: Languages that posts can be written in. The default language is chosen in the system settings.
languages_delete_confirm: Delete this language permanently? Category names in this language are removed as well. This cannot be undone.
languages_add_description: Use a BCP 47 code such as de, pt-BR or zh-Hans. The names are suggested when you leave them empty.
languages_error_invalid_code: Enter a valid BCP 47 language code.
languages_error_default: The default language cannot be disabled or deleted.
languages_error_in_use: Posts use this language, so it can only be disabled.
categories_description: Each category has a name and a URL slug per language. A post can belong to one category.
categories_create_description: A name in the default language is required. Leave a slug empty to create it from the name.
categories_slug_hint: Slugs use lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Names without Latin letters get a short random slug.
categories_delete_description: No post uses this category, so it can be deleted permanently.
categories_error_missing_default: Enter a name in the default language.
categories_error_invalid_slug: The slug for {code} must contain letters or digits.
categories_error_slug_taken: Another category already uses this slug in {code}.
categories_error_in_use: Posts use this category, so it cannot be deleted.
settings_description: Settings that apply to the whole installation. Only the founder can change them.
settings_public_site_hint: When off, Servitor runs headless: the public pages return 404 and content is only available through the API.
settings_require_two_factor: Require two-factor authentication for the founder and admins
settings_require_two_factor_hint: Affected users without two-factor authentication must set it up right after signing in.
settings_api_rate_limit: Default API rate limit (requests per minute)
settings_error_language: Choose an enabled language as the default.
editor_link_invalid: Enter an http, https, mailto or relative link.
editor_link_open: Open link in a new tab
editor_placeholder_paragraph: Write something, or type / for commands
editor_video_description: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link. Other sites cannot be embedded.
editor_video_invalid: This is not a YouTube or Vimeo video link.
media_alt_description: Describe the image for people who cannot see it. Alt text is kept per content language.
media_delete_description: The image and all of its sizes are removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
media_description: Images you uploaded. Media addresses are public but hard to guess: anyone with the link can open an image, even one used only in a draft.
media_empty: You have not uploaded any images yet.
media_error_generic: Something went wrong with the media library. Please try again.
media_error_in_use: This image is used by a post, a cover or a profile and cannot be deleted.
media_error_invalid_image: The file could not be read as an image.
media_error_too_large: Images can be at most 10 MB.
media_error_too_many_pixels: The image is too large. The limit is 40 megapixels.
media_error_unknown_language: One of the languages does not exist.
media_error_unsupported_type: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and AVIF images can be uploaded.
media_picker_description: Pick one of your images or upload a new one.
media_picker_empty: No images yet. Upload one to get started.
media_upload_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF up to 10 MB. Images are converted to WebP and their metadata is removed.
posts_delete_confirm_description: The post, all of its translations and its revision history are deleted. Media files stay in the library. This cannot be undone.
posts_delete_description: Permanently delete the post in every language.
posts_description: Posts you write, with one translation per content language.
posts_error_conflict: This translation was changed in another tab or window. Reload to continue with the latest version.
posts_error_content_too_large: The content is too large to save.
posts_error_generic: The post could not be saved. Please try again.
posts_error_invalid_content: The content contains something that is not allowed.
posts_error_invalid_input: Please check your input and try again.
posts_error_invalid_media: Only images from your own media library can be used.
posts_error_invalid_slug: The slug must contain letters or numbers.
posts_error_network: The draft could not be saved. Check your connection; your changes are kept in this tab.
posts_error_settings_locked: The category and cover cannot be changed while a translation is live and your changes need approval.
posts_error_slug_taken: Another post in this language already uses this slug.
posts_error_tag_too_long: Tags can be at most 50 characters long.
posts_error_too_many_tags: A translation can have at most 20 tags.
posts_error_translation_exists: This post already has a translation in that language.
posts_error_unknown_category: The selected category does not exist.
posts_field_og_image_hint: Shown when the post is shared on social networks.
posts_field_slug_hint: Used in the address of the post. Leave it empty to create it from the title when you save.
posts_read_only: You can view this post and its revisions but you cannot edit it.
posts_saved_to_history: Saved. A new entry was added to the revision history.
posts_settings_description: Shared by every translation of this post.
posts_settings_locked: Category and cover are locked while a translation is live.
profile_avatar_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF up to 10 MB. The picture is cropped to a square.
revisions_description: Every explicit save adds an entry. Restoring copies an entry into the working draft; nothing is published.
revisions_empty: There are no saved revisions yet.
revisions_restored: The revision was restored into the working draft.
posts_error_not_allowed: This action is not available for the translation in its current state.
moderation_description: Hidden posts disappear from the public site and the API until they are unhidden. The owner sees the reason.
moderation_error_reason: Enter a reason for hiding the post.
moderation_error_state: The post was already changed by someone else. Reload the page.
reviews_description: Submissions from authors whose changes need approval before they go live.
reviews_decided_rejected: The submission was rejected. The author can see your note.
reviews_note_hint: Required when rejecting. The author sees it in the editor.
reviews_error_stale: The submission changed after you opened it. Review the latest version.
reviews_error_note_required: Add a note so the author knows what to change.
reviews_error_slug_taken: Another live post in this language already uses this slug. Ask the author to change it.
reviews_error_not_allowed: This submission can no longer be reviewed.
workflow_schedule_hint: Leave empty to publish right away. Scheduling is available until the first publication.
workflow_pending_notice: Submitted changes are waiting for review. Anything already live stays unchanged until they are approved.
workflow_outcome_submitted: Submitted for review. You can keep editing; submitting again replaces the previous submission.
workflow_untrusted_hint: An editor or administrator reviews your changes before they go live.
public_empty: There are no posts here yet.
public_preview_notice: Preview. This version is not public.
api_keys_description: Keys give other applications read-only access to published content through the REST API.
api_keys_name_hint: Describe where the key is used, for example the name of a website.
api_keys_scope_hint: Clear a box to limit the key to the languages or categories you select. Posts without a category are only visible to keys with all categories.
api_keys_rate_limit_hint: Leave empty to use the default of {limit} requests per minute.
api_keys_created: The key {name} was created. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
api_keys_empty: There are no API keys yet.
api_keys_revoke_description: Applications that use it lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
api_keys_error_languages: Choose at least one language or allow all languages.
api_keys_error_categories: Choose at least one category or allow all categories.
api_keys_error_expiry: Choose an expiry date in the future.
api_keys_error_unknown: One of the selected languages or categories no longer exists.
cors_description: Browsers may call the API only from these origins. The panel never sends CORS headers.
cors_origin_hint: Scheme, host and port only, for example https://www.example.com. Wildcards are not allowed.
cors_error_invalid: Enter an origin such as https://www.example.com without a path.
webhooks_description: Notify other systems, such as a static site that needs to rebuild, when published content changes. Payloads never contain content.
webhooks_url_hint: Must use https. Addresses in private networks are refused unless WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE is set on the server.
webhooks_created: The webhook was added. Copy its signing secret now: it is shown only once.
webhooks_rotate_description: Rotating creates a new secret. The old one stops working immediately.
webhooks_rotated: The secret was rotated. Copy the new secret now: it is shown only once.
webhooks_delete_description: Deleting removes the webhook and its delivery log.
webhooks_delete_confirm_description: The endpoint stops receiving events. This cannot be undone.
webhooks_error_url: Enter an https address without a user name, password or fragment.
webhooks_error_too_many: The maximum number of webhooks has been reached.
webhooks_event_published: A translation went live for the first time or was published again.
webhooks_event_updated: The live content of a published translation changed.
webhooks_event_unhidden: A moderator made a post visible again.
email_invite_intro: {inviter} invited you to {site}. Open the link below to choose your password and activate your account.
email_invite_expiry: The link works once and expires in 72 hours.
email_ignore_unexpected: If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.
email_reset_intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your {site} account. Open the link below to choose a new password.
email_reset_expiry: The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
email_reset_ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays unchanged.
email_verify_subject: Confirm your new email address for {site}
email_verify_intro: Confirm that {address} should become the sign-in address of your {site} account.
email_verify_expiry: The link works once and expires in 24 hours. Your address changes only after you confirm it.
email_changed_subject: Your email address for {site} was changed
email_changed_intro: The sign-in address of your {site} account is now {address}. This message goes to your previous address.
email_changed_warning: If you did not make this change, contact an administrator right away.
email_device_intro: Your {site} account was just used to sign in from a device we have not seen before.
email_device_warning: If this was not you, change your password and sign out of your other sessions.
forgot_description: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_requested: If an account exists for {email}, a link to reset the password is on its way. The link expires in 30 minutes.
verify_email_description: Use {email} as the sign-in address of your account from now on?
verify_email_done: Your email address was changed. Use it the next time you sign in.
verify_email_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
profile_email_description_verified: We send a confirmation link to the new address. The change applies once you open it, and your previous address is notified.
profile_email_description_direct: The change applies right away after you confirm it with your password.
profile_email_verification_sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your address changes once you open it.
profile_email_error_taken: Another account already uses this email address.
profile_email_error_unchanged: This is already your email address.
profile_email_error_send: The confirmation email could not be sent. Try again later.
user_link_emailed: We also sent the link to {email}.
user_link_email_failed: The email could not be sent. Share the link yourself.
docs_english_only: The documentation is written in English.
backups_description: Back up the whole installation, the database and every uploaded image, download archives and restore them. Only the founder can use this page.
backups_two_factor_required: Turn on two-factor authentication for your account to use backups. Backups contain all data of the installation.
backups_create_description: The backup runs in the background and is stored on the server next to the database. Sessions are left out, so restoring a backup signs everybody out.
backups_job_running: A backup is being created. With many images this can take a few minutes.
backups_job_succeeded: The last backup, {archive}, was created successfully.
backups_job_failed: The last backup could not be created: {error}
backups_error_busy: A backup is being created right now. Wait until it is finished.
backups_upload_description: Upload an archive from this or another Servitor installation, for example to move to a new server. Uploading changes no data; open the archive afterwards to restore it.
backups_upload_passphrase: Passphrase, if the archive is encrypted
backups_upload_error_space: There is not enough free disk space for this archive.
backups_upload_error_passphrase_required: This archive is encrypted. Enter its passphrase and upload it again.
backups_schedule_description: Servitor can create backups automatically. Only the newest scheduled backups are kept; manual and uploaded backups are never removed automatically. Times are in UTC.
backups_download_description: The archive contains all data of the installation, including password hashes and encrypted secrets. Keep it as safe as the server itself.
backups_download_passphrase_hint: With a passphrase of at least 12 characters, the file is encrypted and can only be restored with the passphrase. Keep the passphrase somewhere other than the file.
backups_restore_description: Restoring replaces the database and all images with this backup. Servitor restarts, everybody is signed out, and the accounts, passwords and two-factor settings of the backup apply. The current data stays on the server in a .pre-restore folder.
backups_restoring_description: Servitor is restarting to restore the backup. This page takes you to the sign-in page when it is back. Sign in with an account from the backup.
backups_restoring_slow: This takes longer than expected. Reload the page in a moment. If Servitor does not come back, check its log.
backups_delete_description: Deleting removes the archive from the server for good.
backups_error_word: Type the confirmation word exactly as shown.
backups_error_passphrase_short: The passphrase needs at least 12 characters.
backups_error_passphrase_long: The passphrase can have at most 1024 characters.
backups_problem_newer_version: It was created by a newer version of Servitor; update this installation first.
backups_problem_schema: Its database does not have the structure Servitor expects.
backups_problem_foreign: It was not created by Servitor.
backups_problem_space: It does not fit into the free disk space.
backups_problem_contents: It contains files that do not belong in a backup.
backups_problem_damaged: The archive or its database is damaged.
backups_last_restore_failed: Restoring {archive} failed on {time}, and the data was not changed. {reason}
email_backup_failed_intro: The scheduled backup of {site} could not be created.
email_backup_failed_action: Check the free disk space and the log, then create a backup by hand under Administration → Backups.
email_backup_downloaded_intro: A complete backup of {site} was just downloaded from the panel with your account.
email_backup_downloaded_warning: If this was not you, change your password and your authenticator right away and sign out of all sessions.
